## Current toolkit map

The current Toolkits menu contains **Protein Extract, Plant-mPLoc, Background Make, Protein Links, Protein Structure, Boxplot, SwissModel, STRINGdb PPI, Stacked Column Diagram, Correlation chord, and Transcriptome Analysis**.

[Plant-mPLoc](Plant_mPLoc.qmd) submits a complete plant protein sequence to the public Plant-mPLoc service and records parsed single/multiple subcellular-localization predictions when an active schema-v4 project is available.

[Transcriptome Analysis](DEG_Analyse.qmd) is the RNA-seq/count-oriented utility. It combines DESeq2 differential expression, PCA, volcano/statistics output and the current maize KEGG GSEA reproduction workflow. It is separate from the main proteomics **DEP analysis**.

## How to use toolkits

Toolkits are intentionally smaller than the main quantitative proteomics pipeline. They prepare identifiers/backgrounds, inspect selected proteins, connect external services, generate focused figures, or provide a specialized analysis outside the core proteomics model.

Keep the input table/sequence together with exported results, use stable identifiers, record taxonomy/database/service settings, and treat structure/network/localization predictions as supporting evidence rather than automatic mechanism.

Where a toolkit supports an active `ProtVis_dataset`, prefer that project-linked route so the result is recorded with parameters and provenance instead of becoming a disconnected manual artifact.
